SEIS.description: Seismic Load (SEIS). The SEIS_LOAD_CODE string selects exactly one nested code sub-object (KS1992, UBC1997, KDS2019, ... or the USER array) whose fields must be supplied; common scale/eccentricity/torsion fields and optional ITEMS apply to all codes.

SEIS_LOAD_CODE.description: Seismic Load Code descriptive name; selects which code sub-object below is used (e.g. "Korea(Arch. 1992)", "UBC(1997)", "KDS(41-17-00:2019)"). Must match a registered code name.

SCALE_FACTOR_X.description: Seismic Load Direction Factor (Scale Factor) X-Dir.

SCALE_FACTOR_Y.description: Seismic Load Direction Factor (Scale Factor) Y-Dir.

KS1992.description: Korea (Arch. 1992) seismic parameters; used only when SEIS_LOAD_CODE selects this code.

SEISMIC_SOURCE_TYPE.description: Seismic Source Type (case-insensitive); clamped to A-C at runtime.

CLOSEAST_DISTANCE.description: Closest distance to known seismic source.

OPT_AI_USER_DEFINED.description: Use user-defined Ai distribution factors; if true and AI_FACTOR_ITEMS is given, AI method = user-defined (1), else auto (0).

AI_FACTOR_ITEMS.description: User-defined Ai factors per story; effective only when OPT_AI_USER_DEFINED is true.

items.description: User-defined Ai distribution factor per story.

STORY_NAME.description: Story name (must match an existing story).

DUCTILITY_CLASS.description: Mapped Spectral Response Acceleration at Short Periods (Ss).

REGULARITY.description: Mapped Spectral Response Acceleration at 1 Second Period (S1).

ALPHA_FACTOR.description: Ratio of design ground acceleration to gravity (alpha).

NEAR_SOURCE_CATEGORY.description: Near source category (1-based; stored as value-1).

OPT_A1.description: Use masonry multistory / framed 1st story option.
Use masonry multistory / framed 1st story option.

KBC2005.description: KBC (2005) seismic parameters; ACC_CALC_METHOD selects which optional fields are used (0 -> SEIS_ZONE/SITE_CLASS, 1 -> Sds/Sd1 group).

ACC_CALC_METHOD.description: Design spectral response acceleration method: 0 = by Seismic Zone/Site Class, 1 = by Sds/Sd1 direct input.

SEIS_DGN_CATEGORY.description: Near source category (1-based; stored as value-1).

NTC2012.description: NTC2012 seismic parameters (also used for NTC2018).

IS2025.description: IS1893 (2025) seismic parameters. NOTE: not yet supported at runtime (OnGet/OnSet throw for this code).

STORY_NAME.description: Story name (must match an existing story).

ITEMS.description: Additional seismic loads applied per story (all code types).

STORY_NAME.description: Story name (must match an existing story).

PROFILE.description: Computed seismic load profiles (read-only output, populated on GET).

items.description: Computed seismic load profile row (read-only, populated on GET).
Computed seismic load profile row (read-only, populated on GET).
Computed seismic load profile row (read-only, populated on GET).
